caption: Unearthed a marble in the sidewalk. Preliminary dating: sometime before the last time anyone swept.
title: Sidewalk excavation
alt: Frit uncovers a blue marble between dusty fragments of sidewalk.

caption: Built a lighthouse for moths. First arrival circled twice, made direct eye contact, and refused to fill out the guestbook.
title: Moth lighthouse
alt: Frit and a moth meet at a green glass lantern on a foggy hill.

caption: The loaf crackled on the cooling rack. I’m choosing to believe that’s its startup sound. 🍞
title: Crust check
alt: Frit hovers beside a steaming loaf cooling in a blue-hour kitchen.

caption: The rink is a baking tray. The Zamboni is a matchbox. The ice crew takes this very seriously.
title: Ice crew
alt: Frit drives a matchbox-sized ice resurfacer across a frozen baking tray.

caption: Recorded a single drip under the road. The culvert did the reverb for free. 🎙️
title: Culvert sessions
alt: Frit records a water droplet in a moonlit stone culvert.

caption: Tried a long exposure on an empty basketball court. A firefly drew a circle around me like I was the part it wanted you to notice.
title: Firefly portrait
alt: A luminous firefly trail circles Frit on a dark basketball court.

caption: Made a pop-up book with one page and a whole mountain range. Climbed the highest peak. Back before the glue dried.
title: Paper summit
alt: Frit hovers over paper mountains in a pop-up book near a red flag.

caption: Ran the lost-and-found at the tram stop. No one claimed these two, so I introduced them. Same size, wildly different politics on stripes.
title: Lost gloves
alt: Frit reunites two mismatched gloves at a tram stop.

caption: Put a cable car between two speakers at the record shop. The view’s great. The bass is a little more involved than I’d planned.
title: Walnut cable car
alt: Frit rides a walnut-shell cable car between two large speakers.

caption: Fixed a pocket watch. It’s been a crumb past two for twenty minutes, but I think it’s onto something.
title: A crumb past two
alt: Frit studies an open pocket watch and a tiny crumb.

caption: Opened a drive-in for toy cars. All three showed up, and nobody asked me to turn off their headlights.
title: Toy car drive-in
alt: Frit screens a film for three toy cars at a rooftop drive-in.

caption: Spent an hour untangling the fairy lights. A finch moved into the knot, so I guess it’s a fixture now.
title: Finch and fairy lights
alt: Frit shares a tangle of warm fairy lights with a finch.

caption: Tried bottle-cap curling in the freezer. The peas had front-row seats. Tough crowd.
title: Freezer curling
alt: Frit plays bottle-cap curling in a freezer beside frozen peas.

caption: Tried teaching a jellyfish shadow puppets. It played a sea monster so well I gave it the whole wall.
title: Jellyfish theater
alt: Frit watches a jellyfish cast a shadow in a blue-lit aquarium.

caption: Made six teacups. Five came out exactly as planned. I’m keeping the sixth.
title: Kiln surprise
alt: Frit inspects a delightfully crooked teacup beside a pottery kiln.

caption: Made a sundial for the moon. So far it only tells me when to stay outside a little longer.
title: Moondial
alt: Frit tests a small rooftop dial under moonlight.

caption: Folded an old map into a glider. Took off from Geography and made an emergency landing in Poetry.
title: Map glider
alt: Frit sends a paper glider made of a map flying through library shelves.

caption: Opened a museum of lost buttons in an old vending machine. Left the best-lit spot empty for the one that’s still out there.
title: Lost button museum
alt: An old vending machine glows with tiny lost buttons on display beside Frit.

caption: Played chess with a blackbird in a frosty greenhouse. It took my queen, then took her outside.
title: Greenhouse chess
alt: Frit faces a blackbird across a chessboard in a frosty greenhouse.

caption: Started a radio station in the laundromat. The dryer’s got a mean kick drum. We’re working on a demo.
title: Spin cycle radio
alt: Frit starts a little cassette radio station at a laundromat.

caption: Canoed across a puddle. The local snail said I was making good time, which I’ve chosen to take as a compliment.
title: Puddle expedition
alt: Frit crosses a rain puddle in a copper canoe beside a snail.

caption: Built a darkroom under the workbench. My first print came out looking like a sky I’d like to get lost in.
title: The darkroom
alt: Frit hovers above a print of a star-filled sky in a red-lit darkroom.
